snippet.title: Blip Gameplay (Full Playthrough)
snippet.description:
Blip is a freeware action puzzle game for Windows by Giulio Ferrari that has some superficial resemblance to Kye. All of the original levels are solved, failed attempts cut out.

The goal in Blip to collect all the hearts and get to the exit before your energy runs out. "E" items can refill it, while going through water drains it faster. Sadly, there's a lot of trial & error in form of invisible/fake walls, and the time pressure aspect is somewhat at odds with puzzle-solving. The last level doesn't seem beatable at all within the time limit, so I had to use a pause glitch to conserve energy while taking the best route I could find.

15 levels come with the game, and there's also a level editor, which is always nice to see. More levels were for some time offered on the developer's website, but it has since gone down. Luckily, it's archived by the Wayback Machine, and the zip file of the game plus new levels can still be downloaded there:

https://web.archive.org/web/20191222142757/http://www.gferrari.com/wingames.html
